title: Starfall Village
wikitext:
[[Image:Starfall Village.jpg|thumb|Starfall Village]]

'''Starfall Village''' is a small outpost of [[Alliance]] [[vendor]]s and [[quest giver]]s in [[Winterspring]]. It is found along the main road, northwest of [[Everlook]] and south of [[Frostsaber Rock]]. It contains an all-but empty [[barrow den]], a [[night elven]] lodge, and also a smaller house, though the village's inhabitants prefer to stay within the more defensible lodge.

The following NPCs can be found here:
*[[Lyranne Feathersong]] - food and drink
*[[Natheril Raincaller]] - general goods
*[[Syurana]] - trade goods
*[[Wynd Nightchaser]] - quests
*[[Jaron Stoneshaper]] - quests
*[[Grum Redbeard]]
